Just picked up my back-ordered copy of @KosherSoul ‘s @thecookinggene  from my #neighborhood bookstore— excited to dive in to this (not a) #beachread . 
#whattheydidntteachmeinschool  #BLM #BlackHistoryMatters #ReadingIsFundamental

I don’t think I have that many followers who pay attention to what I post. But if you are reading this, especially if you’re white, take the moment to watch this. We can’t stop. #BLM can’t just be a trendy hashtag. Some things have changed, but very little. We have to act daily.
